title: Card Desk Guidance: Rent Re-Collected by a Storage Unit Card Catch-Up Charge under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Guidance.** On a storage unit agreement drafted by card under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the rent the card catch-up charge re-collects is:

- **nothing**, while a retry of the declined due date is still allowed, that is while fewer declined attempts (for insufficient funds or an expired card) than one plus the method's number of retries are recorded for it, because the retry collects it;
- **the rent charge less the net direct payments**, where direct payments were taken at a facility office, by phone or online after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date, net meaning less the payment reversals posted on the agreement in that same window — this tier applies where those direct payments less those reversals come to more than nothing;
- **otherwise, the whole rent charge.**

**Records read.** The draft attempts on the authorization for the declined due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date) with a result of declined for insufficient funds or declined for an expired card; and, on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger, payments taken through the facility office, care center phone or online portal channels and payment reversals, each dated after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date.

**Retries by method.**

| Method | Retries after the first attempt | Declined attempts at which no retry is left |
|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | 2 | 3 |
| Credit Card | 2 | 3 |
| Personal Checking ACH | 0 | not a card method |
| Personal Savings ACH | 0 | not a card method |
| Business Checking ACH | 0 | not a card method |
| Business Card | 2 | 3 |

### Window (hypothetical dates)

Handling date 15 May: the window runs from 16 April to 15 May. A payment taken at a facility office on 15 April is outside it; one taken online on 16 April is inside it.

### Cases (hypothetical, Credit Card method, rent charge $180.00)

| Declined attempts recorded for the declined due date | Direct payments in the window | Reversals in the window | Rent re-collected |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 (one retry still allowed) | — | — | Nothing |
| 3 | none | none | $180.00 |
| 3 | $65.00 by phone | none | $115.00 |
| 3 | $65.00 by phone | $65.00 | $180.00 — the net is nothing |
| 3 | $45.00 online and $35.00 at the office | $25.00 | $125.00 |
